text: 1) The 'every 15 seconds' is the CNO scanner only. Vigilant's own scan runs on the GitHub engine, which scans continuously and re-reads when you pull to refresh. The phone doesn't run it on a 15 s timer. The 15 s on the phone is the CNO read and the recheck of listed rows. If you'd like, send me the notification's exact wording or a screenshot and I'll check which one says it. 2) Good idea, noted as CH77. The Growth plan allows 3 leagues, and my current order is NCAAF, NBA, NHL, then NFL. So I'll move NFL into the 3 from about Thursday through Sunday of NFL weeks. I'll also test both Trial keys at once, one connection each, but I need to check first which leagues a Trial key allows. I'll report back here.
